testcase_source.checkout: Use the cheese-work/artemis checkout for PR #311 at the exact candidate head SHA in the CHE-6843 handoff. From its root, git rev-parse HEAD must equal that SHA before execution.
testcase_source.revision_policy: A change to journey, receipt, runner, app source, effective lock, override, fixture contract or pinned goal requires a new candidate revision and fresh independent reviews.

build.verification: Record exact build command/toolchain and verify package, debug variant, version, ABI and APK digest before install. The digest is per-run evidence; source/lock/override/runner/testcase pins keep this testcase revision valid.

model.open_point: No provider call until both independent reviews approve this exact candidate and the Android device squad records AVD admission.

execution.command_template: set -euo pipefail; ARTEMIS_CHECKOUT="$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"; test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = '<candidate head SHA from CHE-6843 handoff>'; EXPECTED_CONFIG_PATH="$(realpath "$ARTEMIS_CHECKOUT")/qualification/configs/che6852_st008_openai.artemis.jsonc"; CONFIG_PATH="$(realpath "$ARTEMIS_CHECKOUT/qualification/configs/che6852_st008_openai.artemis.jsonc")"; test "$CONFIG_PATH" = "$EXPECTED_CONFIG_PATH"; test "$(sha256sum "$CONFIG_PATH" | cut -d' ' -f1)" = '509c567dd553de882f9b5f9d952e7f91a97007bc326ded3fa6336e85f3ea1c6b'; env -u GOOGLE_API_KEY -u GEMINI_API_KEY ARTEMIS_ARTEMIS_JSONC="$CONFIG_PATH" artemis run '<exact goal text>' --standalone --profile pro --assertion-exit --device-serial <leased serial> --locked-app com.palio.ai --disable-planner-validation --verification-level strict --session-id <fresh UUIDv4> --run-id <fresh UUIDv4> --traces-path <run evidence dir>/traces
execution.locked_app_permission_dialogs: When the device policy is enabled for the leased serial, static source review of artemis/runtime/device_policy.py shows the policy requires the resumed package to equal com.palio.ai and latches LeftTestApp otherwise. The permission-controller dialog has a different resumed package. On an unrestricted serial this lock is not enforced as a foreground lock. Runtime behavior is untested; goal_02 remains do not invoke under this candidate.

provider_preflight.check_sources: Before startup, inspect variable names only in the workspace .env, get_env_file() result and GLOBAL_APP_DIR/.env. Stop if any source sets GOOGLE_API_KEY or GEMINI_API_KEY. Do not print or retain values.
provider_preflight.environment: Run through env -u GOOGLE_API_KEY -u GEMINI_API_KEY as pinned in command_template.

execution.spend_rule: Record metered provider spend for each run and cumulative total. Stop before any run that could exceed USD 5 per run or USD 15 total.

checkout.testcase_commit_sha: Exact published PR #311 head SHA returned on CHE-6843; executor verifies it equals git rev-parse HEAD before execution.
checkout.revision: Use the cheese-work/artemis PR #311 checkout. Record its exact published testcase commit SHA and verify git rev-parse HEAD matches before execution.

llm_config.absolute_path_rule: Resolve with realpath from the PR #311 checkout root. Stop unless it equals the expected absolute checkout-root path and its SHA-256 matches.

firebase_debugview.prerequisite: Independent authorized Firebase DebugView fixture and access, recorded by the Android device squad leader.

store_sandbox_purchase.prerequisite: Independent store-sandbox fixture and access, recorded by the Android device squad leader. No purchase is fabricated and no money is spent.

onboarding.fixture: Pinned app-data reset, POST_NOTIFICATIONS grant from reset.launch_permission, and synthetic name Artemis QA. The same clean Welcome-screen fixture supports the separate goal_06 negative control.

fixture.permission: Do not invoke goal_02. Permission prompt behavior is untested on an unrestricted serial and blocked when device policy enforces locked-app foreground checks. Do not infer displayed prompt from focus loss or a pending native call.

speaking.reason: No admitted deterministic speaking session/backend fixture is pinned; this includes event_20 through event_23.

flash_cards.reason: No deterministic nonempty, empty or load-failure deck fixture is pinned; this includes event_24 through event_27.

ads.reason: No controlled display-callback fixture or verified transitive SDK emission fixture is pinned; this includes event_17, event_18 and event_19.

paywall.reason: No verified real weekly/yearly store offers or authorized sandbox fixture is pinned; this includes event_28 through event_32. Never fabricate product IDs or purchase.

login.account: No authorized nonpersonal Google test account is available; do not sign in. Home after login redirect and authentication-family removal checks remain NOT-RUN (event_11, removal_06).

launch_permission.grant: adb -s <leased serial> shell pm grant com.palio.ai android.permission.POST_NOTIFICATIONS

reset.scope: Run only after admission, both reviews and lease. Target the leased serial. Never reset shared device state. Snapshot and restore permission state on the same serial.

setup: adb -s <leased serial> shell setprop debug.firebase.analytics.app com.palio.ai
adb -s <leased serial> shell setprop log.tag.FA VERBOSE
adb -s <leased serial> shell setprop log.tag.FA-SVC VERBOSE
adb -s <leased serial> logcat -v threadtime -s FA FA-SVC
fa_debug.restore: Before setup, capture getprop debug.firebase.analytics.app, getprop log.tag.FA, and getprop log.tag.FA-SVC. Restore each property to its exact captured value; do not assume .none. Disable the capture process after the observation window.

fixture.synchronization: Visible UI plus timestamped FA/FA-SVC capture saved as <run evidence dir>/fa-fa-svc-threadtime.log. Checker reads that exact file using the runner log-reader input; retain that input's SHA-256. Event assertion requires exact event, allowed parameters, count and ordering in the complete observation window.

result_rule.observed_requires: A row is OBSERVED only if the native ledger contains a passed native ledger item naming its assertion_id and reporting the checked count and parameters.
result_rule.exit_zero_rule: Exit 0 alone sets no event or removal row status. Missing or unchecked ledger items remain NOT-RUN with unknown count.
result_rule.removed_family_filter: Count only custom events with origin=app in the FA-SVC log; automatic Firebase events do not count for removal families.

capture: device class, API, ABI and assigned serial
runner, testcase, app source, lock and override revisions
fresh fixture/reset and visible entry state
timestamped redacted FA and FA-SVC logs
per-event and per-removal result with exact count and parameters
first-run, clean-rerun and negative-control result when class qualification applies
evidence_contract.privacy: Never retain names, account identifiers, tokens, transcripts, audio, lesson/session IDs, URLs, purchase identifiers or credential values. Keep raw logs private; retain minimum redacted evidence.

exit_codes.0: All required native assertions complete and pass.
exit_codes.1: Completed native assertion failure, including the deliberate qualification control.
exit_codes.2: Incomplete, malformed, unchecked or inconclusive evidence; never PASS.

evidence_contract.unobserved_count: unknown; never infer zero from missing evidence

qualification.positive_pass: Clean representative testcase pass with complete artifacts.
qualification.clean_rerun: Repeat from the clean reset contract; preserve independent result and artifacts.

negative_control.actual_value: Start practicing English with Palios, your AI speaking buddy.
negative_control.proof: complete native summary has exactly this failed item, the observed title is different, marker ARTEMIS_ASSERTION_EXIT=1 is present, and process exit is 1

qualification.cleanup_release: Preserve evidence, stop only run-owned processes, restore only changed settings, and obtain Android leader verification of device/lease release.
qualification.missing_or_uncertain_evidence: NOT-RUN or inconclusive; never qualify. Uncertain cleanup keeps target unavailable with named recovery owner.

goals.text: Use the pinned clean first-run fixture: reset com.palio.ai, grant POST_NOTIFICATIONS before launch, set locale en, and enter only synthetic name Artemis QA. Stop at the login redirect without signing in. Capture the complete timestamped FA/FA-SVC window and visible states. Assert event_01=splash_scr_view, event_02=obd_1_scr_view, event_03=obd_2_scr_view, event_04=obd_3_scr_view, event_05=lfo_1_scr_view, event_06=lfo_2_scr_view with language=en, event_07=obd_6_scr_view, event_08=obd_7_scr_view, event_09=obd_8_scr_view, exactly once per visible trigger and in observed step order with each row's expected parameters. Assert removal_02=splash_bootstrap_started|splash_bootstrap_completed|splash_bootstrap_failed and removal_04=language_selected|onboarding_started|onboarding_next_tapped|onboarding_completed each have count 0 in the complete captured window. Missing UI or incomplete capture is not PASS.
DO NOT INVOKE. event_12 through event_16 and removal_05 are NOT-RUN because permission-controller dialog behavior is not verified under the pinned locked-app policy.
DO NOT INVOKE. event_20 through event_27 and removal_09 are NOT-RUN because no deterministic speaking-session or flash-card deck fixture is pinned.

DO NOT INVOKE. event_17 through event_19, event_28 through event_32, removal_10 and removal_11 are NOT-RUN because verified ad callbacks, real store offers, and authorized sandbox fixtures are not pinned. Never fabricate impressions or purchases or disable automatic collection.

For the complete FA/FA-SVC window, assert zero occurrences for removal_01=app_open|app_foreground|app_background, removal_02=splash_bootstrap_started|splash_bootstrap_completed|splash_bootstrap_failed, removal_03=navigation_route_changed|screen_view, removal_04=language_selected|onboarding_started|onboarding_next_tapped|onboarding_completed, removal_07=home_tab_selected|practice_tab_selected|redeem_tab_selected|rank_tab_selected|account_tab_selected, removal_08=account_language_opened|account_language_changed|account_rate_app_tapped|account_contact_us_tapped|account_share_app_tapped, and removal_12=api_call_failed|api_call_timeout. Count only custom events with origin=app in the FA-SVC log; automatic Firebase events do not count. The Checker reads the exact saved FA/FA-SVC window from <run evidence dir>/fa-fa-svc-threadtime.log using the runner log-reader input. Preserve automatic Firebase collection. Missing fixture or incomplete capture is NOT-RUN, never zero.

Run the pinned clean onboarding fixture as a separate qualification attempt with locale en. On the Welcome onboarding screen, assert assertion_id=negative_control_title: visible text from onboarding/app_en.arb key welcomeMessage is exactly `Palios — WRONG TITLE`; the real value is `Start practicing English with Palios, your AI speaking buddy.` The native summary must contain exactly one failed item for this assertion, stdout must contain ARTEMIS_ASSERTION_EXIT=1, and process exit must equal 1. Keep this expected failure separate from positive runs; exit 0, exit 2, a missing marker, incomplete evidence or another failed item invalidates the control.

logic_review_findings.requirement: Focus loss during a pending native permission request does not count as a displayed prompt; observe the actual OS dialog.
logic_review_findings.failure_behavior: Fail the assertion or mark NOT-RUN if dialog visibility cannot be proven.

logic_review_findings.requirement: Overlapping notification/microphone requests and native bridge errors preserve safe speaking failure behavior and do not create false prompt events.
logic_review_findings.failure_behavior: Fail on unsafe speaking continuation, duplicate prompt event or ambiguous request result.

logic_review_findings.requirement: Notification status unavailable creates no false telemetry and no extra prompt.
logic_review_findings.failure_behavior: Fail on notification custom event or any additional OS prompt.

logic_review_findings.requirement: Speaking and flash-card real-return counts match the contract, including recovery, cancellation, retries, empty deck and duplicate callback cases.
logic_review_findings.failure_behavior: Fail on any count mismatch or false success/finish.

logic_review_findings.requirement: Inspect actual transitive SDK emissions because Git-source/hosted parity is unverified.
logic_review_findings.failure_behavior: Source-only review or app adapter logs cannot pass SDK emission coverage.
